heading.title: Third Division · Part I · Applications in Specified Cases

article.title: Ninety days.
article.content:
To any court for the exercise of its powers of revision under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (5 of 1908), or the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (5 of 1898).
Period of limitationNinety days.

Time from which period begins to runThe date of the decree or order or sentence sought to be revised.
